title: [27/5/2023] Banana prices
prompt: The graph below gives information about the price of bananas in four countries between 1996 and 2004. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph compares banana prices, measured in US dollars per kilogram, across four different countries: Japan, Germany, France, and the USA, over a nine-year period from 1996 to 2004.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, it is clear that the price of bananas increased in all countries, with the exception of France. In addition, Japan generally recorded the highest prices, while the USA consistently maintained the lowest figures throughout the entire timeframe.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the countries with higher prices, France and Japan both started at approximately $2 per kilogram in 1996. Japanese prices showed significant volatility, peaking at $3 in 1998, before following a pattern of alternating increases and decreases, ending at $2.5 in 2004. Meanwhile, French prices remained relatively stable around $2 until 1999, when they declined to about $1.5, before recovering to their original level by 2004.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the countries with lower costs, Germany started at $1.5 per kilogram in 1996, fluctuating moderately throughout the period and finishing at $1.7. In contrast, the USA showed remarkable stability, with prices hovering between $1 and $1.3 throughout the entire period.
